authorityBasis: Independent review of the isolated batch2 input and UID-free ACTIVE vocabulary and L3 boundary authority only.

clusters.noSeparateRule: Direct use of the quadratic roots sum/product to compare a coefficient or evaluate a simple symmetric expression is primary root-coefficient work; no separate L4 is needed.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Use sign constraints to place each quadratic vertex and relate the set of interval centers that contains both vertices to their positions; enumerate both possible vertex orders; use a tangent line as a repeated-root condition to fix the quadratic scales, then evaluate the requested sum.
clusters.variationPolicy: Vertex ordering and numeric interval data vary; unsupported orderings must be checked against tangent admissibility.
clusters.noSeparateRule: Use a single interval-extrema plus tangency skeleton and retain item-level branch verification.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Use Vieta or the given root polynomial to simplify prescribed function values at both roots; subtract the known expression so the residual quadratic vanishes at those two roots; express it as a scalar multiple of their monic quadratic; determine the scalar from one additional function value and evaluate the requested quantity.
clusters.variationPolicy: The root polynomial, prescribed root values and final requested evaluation vary while the two-root residual reconstruction remains fixed.
clusters.noSeparateRule: The same residual-quadratic reconstruction skeleton applies to both the linear and constant value offsets.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Apply Vieta to integer roots; shift their sum/product to form a fixed integer factor product; enumerate its signed factor pairs, recover the possible coefficient parameter values, and aggregate them.
clusters.variationPolicy: The fixed factor product and parameter expression vary; the signed-integer-pair enumeration is structural.
clusters.noSeparateRule: This finite integer-root factor-pair method is a distinct L4 skeleton.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Use Vieta for the original roots; apply the stated affine transformation to each root; calculate the transformed roots' sum and product, then read the requested new coefficient expression or transformed root sum.
clusters.variationPolicy: The affine map and which transformed symmetric expression is requested vary; the transformed-root calculation remains fixed.
clusters.noSeparateRule: A shared root-map-plus-Vieta skeleton covers sum-only and new-coefficient outputs.

clusters.repeatableSkeleton: Analyze piecewise quadratic extrema and boundary values; determine the horizontal levels with the required number of distinct intersections and impose the level/root-sum condition.
clusters.noSeparateRule: Use the exact ACTIVE root-count-by-extrema template rather than proposing a duplicate L4.
